mark: A live `/v1/completions` request with a JSON grammar under the `deepseek_v41` reasoning parser returns valid output; 0763's defaults leave scheduling unchanged
evidence: README step 1 (pytest, 8 files) and step 2 (bench_suite.py: structured output, scheduler simulation, engram rows) on the candidate image, two boots; the patched-file copy-in is dropped because the candidate image carries 0765/0766 (the PR's 0762/0763). bench_suite.py was also run on 1107, verbatim and through a kwargs shim (ours)
readme_command_defects: Step 1 mounts /tmp/hf-test-cache (small test models such as facebook/opt-125m) and loads a tblib_stub from /tmp; neither exists on sp8. With tblib_stub from scripts/release_tests the run gives 51 failed, 44 errors, 101 passed on both boots, every failure a missing offline Hugging Face resource (pytest-candidate48-boot*.txt.gz). Re-run with the release tests' offline_skip plugin: 101 passed, 95 skipped (all 'needs Hugging Face ... (offline)'), 0 failed, both boots. The PR claims 196 passed; the 95 skipped include all of test_structured_output_manager.py, so the fix's own unit tests did not run here

Step 2 verbatim on 1107 fails before printing any result: SchedulerConfig rejects prefill_long_threshold / max_long_prefills (2 validation errors), both boots. Shim v1 (a plain function in place of SchedulerConfig) broke an import-time class-attribute read and failed both boots; shim v2 (forwarding callable, scheduler modules imported first) ran both boots

structured_output_completions_real_image.note: the bench's 'completions_patched' mode runs the image's own _get_constraint_start; its 'completions_unpatched' mode is a simulation of the old code and gives cs=6 / UUUUUU on every image. Chat modes are unchanged between images (cs=6 UUUUUU thinking; cs=2 UUCCU with </think> mid-draft)

scheduler_defaults_1-lane_arms.result: identical scheduling decisions on candidate-48 (both boots) and 1107 (shim v2, both boots) for both 1-lane arms at 64K/128K/256K

1-lane FCFS (yield off).64K: short_cold 19/19 steps, TTFT 8.122 s; long1 5 aligned chunks, done step 4

1-lane Prefill Yield short (promoted).64K: short_cold and short_cached 1/1 step, TTFT 0.192 s; long1 5 aligned chunks, done step 12

scheduler_non_default_arms.4-lane aligned size-blind: candidate-48: completes (64K short_cold 19/19, long1 done step 12); 1107: livelock, long1 stalls after chunk 1 and short requests never finish within 400 steps, both boots
scheduler_non_default_arms.size-classed arms on 1107: not valid: the shim drops prefill_long_threshold, so they run size-blind

engram_rows.note: PR's sp6 numbers were 86.89/94.11 and 143.78/154.17 us; not part of the mark

pytest_candidate-48.readme_form_boot1: 51 failed, 101 passed, 44 errors (all missing offline HF resources)

measured.interval: the scheduler simulation and structured-output decisions are deterministic and identical across boots; CPU timings vary by up to about 20 us/step between boots

parts.part: live /v1/completions with a JSON grammar under deepseek_v41 returns valid output
parts.detail: needs a live server. Offline, the bench's real-code path on the candidate image constrains from token 0 (cs=0, CCU bitmask, invalid token masked, '{' sampled) where 1107 leaves every row unconstrained (cs=6, UUUUUU) and samples the invalid token

offline scheduler simulation: both 1-lane arms (FCFS and the promoted prefill-yield short) make identical decisions on candidate-48 and 1107 at 64K, 128K and 256K, both boots. 1107's side needed our kwargs shim

verdict_scope: sp8-evaluable parts only; the live completions request is cannot-evaluate-on-sp8
reason: The PR's bench shows the completions grammar fix working in the integrated image (constraint from token 0, invalid draft trimmed and masked) and the bug present in 1107, and the 1-lane scheduling path is decision-for-decision identical to 1107. Two caveats: the PR's own structured-output unit tests could not run on sp8 (no offline test models), and the 1107 side of the scheduler comparison is an adapted run through our shim.
notes: commands.txt start_utc is when the command was issued and includes any wait on /tmp/spark-lab-gpu.lock; batches queued on the lock interleave in the raw log, and each end block names its output file
pytest-candidate48-boot*.txt are gzipped (4.9 MB each raw, mostly offline tracebacks)
bench-summary.txt is a derived digest of the bench outputs (analyze/a1013.py)
